SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-01-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-05-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF FREDRICK LOO WONG IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT PATRICK MOKHTARZADEH IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $376.44 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCES IS REQUIRED AT THE APRIL 5TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES AT THE NEXT HEARING THIS CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF FREDERICK LOO WONG IS ALLOWED TO BE HEARD, (THOUGH HIS ZOOM APPEARANCE REQUEST IS UNTIMELY) TO INFORM THE COURT IF HE RECEIVED PAYMENT OF SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AMOUNT. HAD HE NOT RECEIVED PAYMENT A JUDGMENT IN THE SAME AMOUNT WOULD HAVE BEEN RENDERED ON THE DEFENDANT; HOWEVER THE PLAINTIFF RECEIVED PAYMENT. DEFENDANT IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
